hook: Jeedimetla's Ranga Theatre may become the *world's first* single-screen Dolby Cinema
hook_b: Jeedimetla's Ranga Theatre may become the *world's first* single-screen Dolby Cinema
tldr: Siasat reports that Mythri Movie Makers is renovating Ranga Theatre in Jeedimetla, which it took over a few months ago, as a Dolby Cinema. It is reportedly expected to reopen in the first week of December; an official confirmation of the date and technical details is awaited.

beats.what: A Jeedimetla single screen is being rebuilt with Dolby Cinema technology.
beats.why: Renovated single screens like Sudarshan, Devi and Sandhya still draw crowds despite OTT and multiplexes.
beats.care: North Hyderabad may get a premium screen without a multiplex trip, if it opens as reported.

causes.label: Single screens losing to OTT, multiplexes

event.label: Ranga Theatre rebuilt as Dolby Cinema

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Siasat (Nov 20): Hyderabad already got Asia's largest Dolby screens at Allu Cinemas earlier this year.

facts.t: Mythri's renovated Vimal Theatre in Balanagar has a *70-foot* screen and keeps ticket and canteen prices relatively affordable.

watch: Official confirmation of Ranga Theatre's reopening date and specifications.

fact: Jeedimetla's Ranga Theatre is reportedly set to be the *world's first* single-screen Dolby Cinema
twist: Single screens are closing across the Telugu states, but Mythri has already revived Vimal in Balanagar and Ganga in Dilsukhnagar.
